title: Vulnerability Analysis for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement
abstract: arXiv:2610.27293v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SMARL) aims to learn cooperative control policies under prescribed safety constraints. Al- though existing SMARL methods focus on enforcing safety during policy optimization, their vulnerability remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates inference-time observation attacks against SMARL, where an adversary perturbs the observations of a subset of agents, thereby altering the actions produced by their policies. We propose MinMax Attack, an attack framework that jointly selects adversarial target actions for compromised agents while accounting for the Cooperative Resistance of benign agents. We further derive a bound on the induced safety cost and characterize its relation- ship with the Compromised-Agent Budget and the Perturbation Budget. translated_title: 安全多智能体强化学习的脆弱性分析
translated_abstract: 安全多智能体强化学习（SMARL）旨在学习在规定安全约束下的协作控制策略。尽管现有的SMARL方法专注于在策略优化过程中强制执行安全性，但其脆弱性在很大程度上尚未被探索。本文研究了针对SMARL的推理时观测攻击，即攻击者对一部分智能体的观测进行扰动，从而改变其策略所产生的动作。我们提出了MinMax攻击，这是一个攻击框架，它为被攻陷的智能体联合选择对抗性目标动作，同时考虑良性智能体的协同抵抗。我们进一步推导了由此引发的安全代价的上界，并刻画了该代价与被攻陷智能体预算和扰动预算之间的关系。在多个安全关键的多智能体基准任务以及代表性的最先进SMARL算法上的实验表明，MinMax攻击能够诱导显著的……
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了安全多智能体强化学习在推理时观测攻击下的脆弱性，提出考虑良性智能体协同抵抗的MinMax攻击框架，并推导出安全代价上界及其与被攻陷智能体预算和扰动预算的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of the vulnerability of Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning to inference-time observation attacks, proposing the MinMax Attack framework that accounts for cooperative resistance of benign agents and deriving a bound on safety cost in relation to the compromised-agent and perturbation budgets.
